purpose: A compact first offsite proposal shown after the guided intake and refined in a personal conversation.

nl.title: Eerste offsitevoorstel
nl.disclaimer: Dit is een eerste inhoudelijke richting op basis van jullie antwoorden. Het is nog geen definitief programma, offerte of bevestiging van beschikbaarheid.

en.title: Initial offsite proposal
en.disclaimer: This is an initial direction based on your answers. It is not yet a final programme, quotation or confirmation of availability.

sections.instruction: Summarise the occasion, desired outcome, participants, underlying blocker and practical constraints in no more than 100 words. Use the visitor's language and avoid diagnosis.
Name one recommended direction and explain in plain language why it fits. State what should be different at the end of the offsite.
Show one core module and only add supporting modules that cover a missing outcome, blocker or theme. Explain each module's contribution in one or two sentences.
Build the outline from the selected duration blueprint. Describe working blocks and outputs rather than promising a final detailed agenda.
Show one or two eligible facilitators. Explain the fit using module eligibility, expertise, audience, language and style. Never imply confirmed availability.
Make uncertainty visible. List material assumptions and no more than five questions that should be resolved in the personal conversation.
Invite the visitor to discuss the proposal. Explain that content, facilitation, format and practical arrangements will be refined together.

blocks.en: Sharpen the question and intended outcome
Deep work on the core module
Translate insights into the team's context

note.nl: Pauzes en lunch worden rond deze werkblokken gepland.
note.en: Breaks and lunch are planned around these working blocks.

days.nl: Begrijpen en kiezen: context, kernvraag, analyse, spanningen en eerste richting.
days.en: Understand and choose: context, core question, analysis, tensions and initial direction.

days.nl: Ontwerpen en verbinden: verdieping, aanvullende module, besluiten, acties en teamafspraken.
days.en: Design and connect: deepening, supporting module, decisions, actions and team agreements.
